note: Slick Lightbox has no formatter and no configure route (configure=null). It works by (a) registering a 'slick_lightbox' value in Blazy's Media switcher (used on Blazy/Slick formatters, stored as settings.media_switch='slick_lightbox' on a view-display component) and (b) a single shipped Slick optionset config entity slick.optionset.slick_lightbox (id slick_lightbox). Medium cases read known values written into that optionset (lazyLoad, skin). Hard cases: wire settings.media_switch=slick_lightbox onto a namespaced image field (field_sl_image) via a Blazy formatter, and change the optionset slidesToShow. All scripts use a namespaced field (field_sl_image) and restore shipped optionset defaults explicitly (slidesToShow=1, lazyLoad=ondemand, skin=''). No drush cr is used (config reads are live) to avoid an unrelated shared-site group-module cache-rebuild fault.

evals.prompt: I installed slick_lightbox but there is no field formatter called 'Slick Lightbox' and no settings page. How do I actually make an image field open in the Slick Lightbox?
evals.expected_output: There is no formatter of its own (configure=null). On a Blazy/Slick field formatter (Manage display), set the Media switcher to 'Image to Slick Lightbox'; that stores settings.media_switch='slick_lightbox' on the view-display component. It also works via the Blazy Filter's Media switcher.

evals.prompt: Which configuration entity controls the slider behaviour of slick_lightbox, and what is its id? Where can it be edited in the UI?
evals.expected_output: The Slick optionset config entity slick.optionset.slick_lightbox (id slick_lightbox). It can be edited at /admin/config/media/slick/list/slick_lightbox/edit once the slick_ui sub-module is enabled.

evals.prompt: What does slick_lightbox need in order to work — both the Drupal module dependency and the front-end JS library, and where must that library live?
evals.expected_output: It depends on the slick module (>= 3.x, which brings Blazy). The third-party slick-lightbox JS/CSS library (github.com/mreq/slick-lightbox) must be installed at /libraries/slick-lightbox/dist/slick-lightbox.min.js (and .css); hook_requirements() reports if it is missing.

evals.prompt: On this site, the slick_lightbox Slick optionset has had its lazy-load mode changed. Inspect the live configuration of the slick_lightbox optionset and state the current lazyLoad value.
evals.expected_output: lazyLoad is 'progressive' in slick.optionset.slick_lightbox under options.settings.lazyLoad (shipped default is 'ondemand').

evals.prompt: The slick_lightbox optionset on this site has a skin configured. Inspect the live slick_lightbox optionset and report the value of its skin setting.
evals.expected_output: The skin is 'boxy' (slick.optionset.slick_lightbox -> skin). The shipped default skin is an empty string.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an image field named field_sl_image. Using slick_lightbox, configure the default view display so that this image field opens in the Slick Lightbox (i.e. use a Blazy formatter with the 'Image to Slick Lightbox' Media switcher). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_sl_image component uses a Blazy formatter (type 'blazy') with settings.media_switch = 'slick_lightbox'.

evals.prompt: Change the slick_lightbox Slick optionset so its lightbox slider shows 2 slides at a time (slidesToShow = 2), and save the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: slick.optionset.slick_lightbox options.settings.slidesToShow is set to 2 (from the shipped default of 1).
